# partiteai_eval_mesh_monitor (Resource)

Scores a share of a mesh's conversations against a rubric as they happen. Requires an enterprise deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is scoring. A disabled monitor keeps what it has already written.
- `mesh_id` (String) Mesh whose conversations are scored.
- `model_set_id` (String) Model set the judging runs on.
- `rubric_id` (String) Rubric the conversations are scored against.
- `sample_rate` (Number) Share of conversations to score, from 0 to 1.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
